684f719376e2499045047901 note: Build an AKMN with low recoil, good ergonomics, and a tactical device.
684f719376e2499045047901 description:
There’s this guy I deal with — scav turned fixer. Works out of a shipping container under a broken crane. Wants something that won't jam, won't kick like a mule, and doesn’t rattle when he runs. Says he needs an AKMN — durable, clean, under control.

Here’s the breakdown:
- Durability 60 or better. He’s not cleaning this thing.
- Recoil 174 or less. He’s not bracing for every shot.
- Ergonomics at least 50. Can’t risk pulling a muscle aiming.
- Magazine holds 30+ rounds.
- Must fit tight — 2 slot tall, 8 wide max.
- Needs a tactical attachment: flashlight or laser — he works in the dark.

Ugly’s fine. Reliable’s better. Deliver it.
684f719376e2499045047901 startedMessageT: Make something he can trust when his hands are shaking.
684f719376e2499045047901 successMessageT: That’ll keep him alive another night. Appreciate it.
